## Cheap optional attribution and its limit

If an authenticated delivered baseline Wasm is already available, one `wasm-objdump -h`/`-x`/`-d` comparison may help explain the changed bytes. This is optional descriptive evidence, not a new prerequisite or substitute for current consumer gates. No broad binary-normalization tool or second build framework is authorized. Equal section sizes do not mean equal code; equal code bytes with changed data can still change behavior. Use “metadata/layout-only” only if exact relevant byte comparisons substantiate it. Otherwise report the narrow observed fact: new source changes the artifact digest, while the existing production qualification passes. Do not spend the feature's delivery budget chasing a cosmetic binary explanation.
